answer: The ocean counter is kept in mirror and prism makes public each reset. A bond is refunded only after 30 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An attacker thus has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 30 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 49 times over for the same share of the pool. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
